hypothesis: The fixed receipt-delivered adaptive terminal shortlist improves aggregate source-selection accuracy while reducing model tokens and elapsed time against native convergence across four untouched language/repository strata.
selection_rule: The first lexicographic source-only task ID for each of four available language/repository strata that was absent from prior local benchmark evidence and had its base commit in the pinned VPS cache; no gold labels inspected.
decision_rule: Run and report all four frozen tasks regardless of earlier outcomes. Seal each matched pair before pinned native scoring. An aggregate campaign pass requires all four pairs scoreable, candidate macro-mean Span-F1 and File-F1 both strictly above control, summed known model tokens and summed measured duration both strictly below control, and no more than one task with lower Span-F1. Report every task regression and validity failure; a later source or task change begins a new campaign.
claim_ceiling: Four-task cross-language G01 directional campaign only; not full ContextBench or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
